Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly pivoted from the clearly supported target (Atari Assembler Editor by Shepardson Microsystems) to MAC/65 by OSS, misinterpreting the clue “company noted for authoring Atari’s BASIC.” This context drift ignored prior evidence that Shepardson authored Atari BASIC and that Kathleen O’Brien programmed the cartridge-based Assembler Editor, leading toward an erroneous answer (Stephen D. Lawrow) unrelated to the specified company.
